scopeLimits: The WUP centroid is a population-cluster point, not a cadastral parcel or municipal limit. The municipal Guía Urbana is a planning/reference map and does not establish parcel boundaries. Municipal cadastral procedures establish a local registry function, not anonymous parcel-vector access. No owner, property tax, address, applicant, or account data was queried or retained; no login, CAPTCHA, or credentials were used.
name: Santa Cruz de la Sierra
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Santa Cruz de la Sierra municipal government lists a Dirección de Gestión Catastral and property cadastral procedures, including property valuation, registration of subdivisions/urbanizations, and issuance of provisional property-tax nomenclature. The municipality’s Guía Urbana is an official public map for urban planning and reference, but its listed layers focus on services, districts, roads, and planning; no parcel-vector or cadastral layer was verified.
